gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed World Health Organization (WHO) glioblastoma multiforme (GBM), IDH wild-type

candidate_evidence.quote: The study drug WP1066 targets a specific pathway, known as STAT3, which is responsible for promoting tumor growth and causing the body's immune system to avoid attacking the tumor.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: IV. Assess systemic immunological responses and phosphorylated (p)-STAT3 inhibition in patients with glioblastoma. (Cohort 1 and 2)
II. To ascertain the changes induced in the tumor microenvironment by the combination of WP1066 and radiation. (Cohort 2)

role_evidence.quote: Patients whose tumor was completely removed at the time of initial surgery receive WP1066 PO for 6 weeks during routine radiation therapy, and then for twelve 28-day cycles on study.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: WP1066 targets a specific pathway, known as STAT3, which is responsible for promoting tumor growth and causing the body's immune system to avoid attacking the tumor.

source_quote.quote: Documentation of O6-methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase (MGMT) unmethylated status per testing at any Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendment (CLIA) certified laboratory

Documentation of isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild-type status will be by IDH1 R123H immunohistochemistry, except for patients =\< age 54 for whom IDH sequencing will be required to detect noncanonical IDH mutations
IV. Assess systemic immunological responses and phosphorylated (p)-STAT3 inhibition in patients with glioblastoma. (Cohort 1 and 2)

coder_notes: Radiotherapy-only backbone (no temozolomide) in MGMT-unmethylated IDH-wt GBM; WP1066 is the sole investigational drug. Two non-randomised experimental cohorts by resection status, no control arm. Cohort 2 includes post-treatment surgery to study tumour microenvironment changes (target engagement). No tumour/CSF drug concentration measurement stated. Ondansetron, acetaminophen, diphenhydramine mentioned only as allowed/premedication, not listed.
